description: Implementation of various matrix multiplication operators for torch, including classes for torch.mm, torch.addmm, torch.bmm, and torch.matmul, with input spec generation and codegen methods.

classes.name: MatrixMultiplyOperator
classes.description: Base class for matrix multiplication operations, providing common methods for dtype compatibility and production checks.

classes.name: MMOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.mm, handling 2D tensor matrix multiplication.

classes.name: AddmmOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.addmm, handling 2D tensor additive matrix multiplication.

classes.name: BmmOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.bmm, handling batch matrix multiplication for 3D tensors.

classes.name: MatmulOperator
classes.description: Operator class for torch.matmul, handling general tensor matrix multiplication with various dimensions.

methods.name: can_produce
methods.description: Checks if the operator can produce output of a given spec based on tensor dimensions and dtype.

methods.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
methods.description: Generates input tensor specifications for the respective matrix multiplication operation.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates Python code string for performing the matrix multiplication operation with proper dtype casting.
